description: This is a PHP source file ('aor_utils.php') that contains utility functions related to report generation in SuiteCRM. It includes functions for handling date ranges, converting dates, retrieving display labels for fields, processing report parameters, and managing related modules and fields within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getDisplayForField
methods.description: Returns display labels for a module path and field, resolving module relationships and translating labels.

methods.name: requestToUserParameters
methods.description: Processes HTTP request parameters to generate report parameters, handling multi-select and date types.

methods.name: getConditionsAsParameters
methods.description: Retrieves and formats report conditions as parameters, resolving module relationships and decoding stored conditions.

methods.name: getPeriodDate
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object representing the start date for a specified period label (e.g., today, last_month).

methods.name: getPeriodEndDate
methods.description: Returns a DateTime object representing the end date for a specified period label.

methods.name: calculateQuarters
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the four quarters of the year, with optional offset.

methods.name: convertToDateTime
methods.description: Converts a user-entered date string into a DateTime object in UTC, considering user preferences and date formats.
